content.comment_body: Hello. Is it possible to update [product_name] to the latest version? Thank you.

Hello [user_name], English is preferred for communication in this forum. Please write your posts in English. Thank you. Translation: No, updating is not possible. You must uninstall the previous version before installing the new one.

analysis.insight_summary: User wants to update [product_name] to the newest release but learns that updating directly is not possible; instead, the old version must be uninstalled before installing the new one. This process requires additional manual steps and may interrupt workflow, revealing that the product lacks simple update functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to update [product_name] directly to the latest version without needing to uninstall the current installation.
